_note: The Flesh Market (Host): a cyber-organic vendor in the Hive. Sells contraband for DNA, buys any item at value × buyRate. Stock rotates every real-time day (seeded by date). Appetite: feeding it organs it craves raises its mood, which lowers prices; selling it what it hates sours it.

vendor.label: The Gullet Broker
vendor.brief: A vast, sessile organism grown into the Hive wall: a translucent gullet three storeys tall with a choir of small human-sized hands reaching out of it to hand you goods, an iris of cybernetic lenses where a face should be, and a payment slit that swallows DNA. It speaks through a dozen throats at once, slightly out of sync. It is pleased by organs and offended by tech.

heartHusk.label: Heart Husk
heartHusk.effect: on death, revive once with 50% Biomass after 3 s; the husk bursts out of your back
